Name: First Order
Information:
**First Order**

The First Order of the Blackwind were kits’adria who served and trained under Samaru when he was a mortal kits’adria, but remained with him after his transformation. They wish to save the Blackwind lineage, but their devotion to the daiyokai has turned them into yokai over time, similar but not like the closely related yurei’adria. They are creatures of night and shadow who spread the word of Samaru, and act as guides to the rest of the Blackwind Temple. They often act as Samaru’s personal assassins.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description: The fiend’s spellcasting ability is Wisdom. They can cast the following spells innately, requiring no material components:

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The fiend makes three Shadow Fist attacks.

actions.name: Shadow Fist
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d8) psychic damage.

bonus_actions.name: Shadow Swim
bonus_actions.description: If they are in dim light or darkness, the fiend dissolves into a puddle of darkness and reappears in another unoccupied space that is in dim light or darkness within 60 feet of them, then the next attack they make before the end of the turn has advantage.

bonus_actions.name: Shape Change
bonus_actions.description: The fiend changes their voice and body to assume the appearance of another Medium or Small creature they choose, or return to their true form. Their statistics do not change, except for their size. If they are incapacitated or killed, they return to their true form.
